# ScanPlay

> ScanPlay (https://scanplay.org) turns a photo of your study notes into a revision game path (flashcards, quiz, listening, writing, dictation). Built for students on mobile and desktop.

## Product facts (authoritative)

- Website: https://scanplay.org
- Free to start: one trial scan without an account.
- That guest trial scan is free and does **not** consume the ScanPlay AI envelope. After creating a free account, AI usage starts at **0%**.
- Guest trial limit: **1 scan per device/browser**. Refreshing, quitting, or reopening the site does not grant another free guest scan.
- After the trial scan, a free account is required to play steps and save progress.
- **There is no daily scan quota** (the old "2 scans a day" limit no longer exists).
- Free accounts include a weekly **ScanPlay AI** envelope of **€0.15/week**. Scans, coach, and summaries share the same usage %.
- Paid plans enlarge the ScanPlay AI envelope; nothing forces a paid upgrade.
- Supported input: images (photo of a sheet, textbook page, screenshot). PDFs not yet supported.
- Privacy: sheets are tied to the user account and are not public.

## FAQ (short)

Q: Is ScanPlay really free?
A: Yes. The first trial scan needs no account and does not use ScanPlay AI (usage stays at 0% after signup). There is no daily scan quota. Free accounts then get a ScanPlay AI envelope of €0.15/week.

Q: Do I need an account?
A: Not for the first trial scan. An account is required to launch games and save progress. Only one guest scan per device.

Q: Does the guest scan use my AI quota?
A: No. The no-account trial scan does not bill the ScanPlay AI envelope.

Q: Is there a 2 scans/day limit?
A: No. That old daily scan quota was removed. Limits are expressed as a ScanPlay AI usage % on a weekly (Free) or monthly (Plus/Pro/Max) envelope.
